title: PairConfirm
description: Canonical v1 request to confirm a pairing handshake with the 6-digit PIN. Legacy code-based and proof-based pairing fields are rejected by additionalProperties: false.

session_id.description: Pairing session identifier from the /pair/start response

pin.description: Six-digit numeric PIN displayed by the server

michi_id.description: Identity derived as base64url(BLAKE3(public_key)), exactly 43 chars, no padding

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key in base64url, exactly 43 chars, no padding
